result.topic_en: Riemann works on the steady flow of heat (potential problem) in a ring-shaped body whose cross-section is bounded by two circles, transforming the Laplace-type differential equation into bipolar coordinates $\rho e^{\phi i}$ defined by $r+zi=\frac{a+\beta\,\rho e^{\phi i}}{1+\rho e^{\phi i}}$ and seeking particular solutions as series.

methods.what: Conformal (bipolar) map sending the two boundary circles to circles of constant modulus
methods.quote: Setzt man $r+zi=\frac{a+\beta\rho e^{\phi i}}{1+\rho e^{\phi i}}$

methods.what: Relation between parameters of the circles
Substitution $u=r^{\mu}U$ with $\mu=-1/2$ removing the first-order term
Complex coordinates expressing the Laplacian as a mixed derivative
Transformed PDE in the new coordinates $\log\rho,\phi$
Separation of variables: series of particular integrals with $\cos m\phi$, $\sin m\phi$ and an ODE for the radial factor P
